notes.title: Upcoming V.0.1.9 on DDV and the announcement of official game DDOG
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=49Xg_80X4EY;full][/previewyoutube]

สวัสดีชาวไคจู! Hello kaiju fan! Today I'd like to announce next upcoming patch of DDV, and it will be the last major update for this free fan game VERSUS project. For now, all the development progress has been shift to the official title DAIKAIJU DAIKESSEN: OPERATION GUARDIAN [DDOG] That will be available as standalone game *Paid DLC later. You can expect this DDV store page to be change into "DAIKAIJU DAIKESSEN OG" in the near future. But still, there will be various bugs fix for DDV to make it more accessible as good as DDOG 

DAIKAIJU DAIKESSEN: OPERATION GUARDIAN is the summary of all original ideas from every DD titles together. To make a first official game of this franchise. The game will focus on single player story driven type of game 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38757580/10b6c37d0b4bcd66199c1aad146205a5faaa40ff.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38757580/5ea8bde24eb36c6ac0362c43b24b632134c45127.png[/img]

There're various DD game that will be available for free with OG later too 
https://youtu.be/eGHe3hasFHw

https://youtu.be/nYGWIR_elqU?t=34


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38757580/6a5ded96ba8c5e153fb5da2455f70a56a2557882.png[/img]
P.S. I see a lot of people encounter the problem when boosting the game and I do realized that PGMMV engine not stable enough at the moment to handle it. So, I decided to revamp all the graphics and contents to make a game space less than 700 MB. I have to admit that for next DDV update will turn to be one huge downgrade to make the game accessible to everyone. 

Game resolution will down size to 1280*720px from original 1920*1080. 
Survival mode will be merge with Versus mode and there's no shop and the use of currencies for this game anymore. All the promises story features have been moved to DDOG project instead. 
But I do included a new gameplay to mission mode. Which come from one of OG gameplay materials that introduced a free roam adventure to player in Rogue RPG style.

Please follow my project on: [url=https://twitter.com/ProjectOsp]Twitter[/url] for more update
Considered support me on: [url=https://ko-fi.com/ospproject]Ko-fi[/url] For games and art projects

notes.title: V.0.1.7 Hot fix
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38757580/f0eeff6d3d1a3e71b3bc1d07ff7ace76dbf797c5.jpg[/img]

Reworking on input method now. With the helps of https://twitter.com/Abstract_Originhttps://twitter.com/Abstract_Origin So we can come up with input switching during gameplay 

There will be this little icon show up to notify you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38757580/d301c6ead494976302836e93ca006f6156df61d5.png[/img]

When you press the SELECT button on your controller. It will automatic switch input primary to your controller. In the same way, if press F2 will make it primary to keyboards too. Hope this improve gaming experience for you all.

Also, I've enable mouse pointer and setting menu tab to default. So when you start the game it will launch as windowed mode again.

You can press ESC to switch between Fullscreen/Windowed mode.
Press F1 to enable/disable setting tab

Thanks for playing!

-OSP

notes.title: HOT PATCH VER.0.1.7 NOW LIVE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38757580/0af7d0e98bcac93fdfc41db8fee3a24683a77e51.png[/img]

[h1]DAIKAIJU DAIKESSEN: VERSUS (VER.0.1.7)[/h1]

This is a hot patch to fixed various problem from community feedback
Here's the lists of some changing

[list]
[*] Ability to reselect character in character select screen
